Take in-person, paper-based LPI exams at @sfscon@mastodon.social 2026, at NOI Techpark in Bolzano, Italy, Nov. 13. 🐧💪

Choose from #LinuxEssentials, #SecurityEssentials, #LPIC, #DevOps, #BSD, and more.

With the conference’s support, the exams are free of charge!

Seats are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Register now: https://lpi.org/ky7q


#SFSCON26 #LPI #freesoftware #Linux #FOSS
